title: Single Discipline
problem: Grows with the square of the cast count (3 casts = +90%, text = +30%).
notes: In-game test: Single Discipline: cast one spell 3 times at once (e.g. with extra casts); damage gets +30% Intelligence total, not +90%. Fix: S/H

release_notes.intended: The spell gets 10% more Intelligence for each time it is cast at once.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, the bonus grew with the square of the count instead of once per cast.
release_notes.fix: Now it is a flat 10% per cast.
